note: Point-in-time record only. No code, config, or model was modified to produce this checkpoint. Does not authorize any future experiment.

control.description: Frozen, unmodified GAP19 Option-B MILP and its supporting production infrastructure. None of these files were edited.

research_v2.description: Files created or modified to implement the v2 Essential-tier extension. The only files touched during this work.
research_v2.isolation_verification: repo-wide grep for 'GAP19HighsNativeOptimizerMILPV2Research' and 'gap19_highs_native_milp_v2_research' matches only the two files listed as created below

files.change: added two optional keyword-only fields (load_served_essential, unmet_essential), default None, omitted from to_dict() when unset; backward-compatible

rev3_design_elements_implemented: p_served_essential[t], P_unmet_essential[t] decision variables (N=456 total, vars 408-455)
bus-bar balance amended to sink p_served_essential
P_unmet_essential folded into existing J4 at identical 1.0*dt coefficient, no new stage
rev3_items_explicitly_not_implemented: infeasibility -> OptionD routing (withdrawn; V2 mirrors GAP19 fail-closed behavior exactly)
deferrable_loads scheduling semantics (duration/window) - out of scope

simulated_assumptions.label: SIMULATED_RESEARCH_ASSUMPTION
simulated_assumptions.basis: no governance document states which tier curtailable_loads belongs to; TIER2_MAPPING_COMPARISON.md and REV3_UNRESOLVED_ITEMS_AUDIT.md item 2 leave this open and surface counter-evidence (deferrable_loads priority:2 field with no curtailable_loads counterpart)
curtailable_loads schema has no time-of-day field; only non-inventive choice

simulated_assumptions.assumption: Essential tier max_power_w sourced from config["loads"]["curtailable_loads"][0], defaulting to schema's 5000.0W if absent

known_limitations: infeasibility -> OptionD routing remains unresolved per REV3_UNRESOLVED_ITEMS_AUDIT.md item 1; real fallback lives in worker.py (Gate-02 relaxed re-solve -> BLOCKED_INFEASIBLE halt), whose relaxation mechanism (allow_flexible_load_relaxation) is a pre-existing defect in the frozen control, not introduced or fixed by V2
deferrable_loads scheduling semantics not modeled; out of scope for v2
Tier 2 vs Tier 3 mapping for curtailable_loads remains genuinely open; new counter-evidence (priority:2 field) not yet resolved by governance

MILP tie-breaking / solver-path degeneracy observed in smoke-test scenarios 3 and 5: GAP19 and V2 can select different but equally-optimal hour-by-hour dispatch schedules under ties, without affecting any objective value or audited invariant
no broad simulation has been run; 347-origin experiment explicitly not executed
solve times in this sandboxed environment are slow for harder MIP instances (~140s observed), an environment characteristic not a defect

scenarios.name: critical_only_demand
scenarios.note: essential_demand=0 everywhere; V2 structurally inert, identical to GAP19

scenarios.name: sufficient_renewable
scenarios.note: demonstrates Rev.3 double-counting fix; GAP19 unmet_load=4000 despite available energy, V2 unmet_load=0

scenarios.name: insufficient_renewable
scenarios.note: essential never served across all 24h due to fuel-cost (J3) priority over J4; J1-J3 bit-identical, J4 diverges by exactly 96000 (=4000x24x1.0dt); schedule-degeneracy finding present

scenarios.name: essential_vs_battery_charging
scenarios.note: essential served 100% of all 24 hours; GAP19 charge rate exceeds V2's by exactly 4000W at every hour

scenarios.name: reserve_requires_charging
scenarios.note: essential_demand=0 by construction; all four J1-J4 objective values bit-identical between GAP19 and V2; schedule-degeneracy finding present

scenarios.name: infeasible_fail_closed
scenarios.note: inverted SOC bounds reproduce genuine HiGHS infeasibility; both return identical OPTIMIZATION_INFEASIBLE zero-dispatch plans; V2 confirmed not to invoke OptionDFallbackSolver

schedule_degeneracy_finding.description: specific hour-by-hour diesel/battery dispatch schedule differs between GAP19 and V2 while J1-J4 objective values remain bit-identical (scenario 5: all four stages identical; scenario 3: J1-J3 identical, J4 diverges only by the expected essential-tier term)
schedule_degeneracy_finding.attributed_cause: MILP branch-and-bound tie-breaking sensitivity to variable count (456 vs 408), inherent to the frozen diesel unit-commitment formulation under degenerate ties
schedule_degeneracy_finding.classification: not a behavior change to GAP19; does not affect any audited invariant
